entries.text: You see Irwin.
entries.source_text: You see Irwin.

entries.text: Oh boy, can't you leave me alone? I have enough problems on my hands already.
entries.source_text: Oh boy, can't you leave me alone? I have enough problems on my hands already.

entries.text: Problems? Maybe I can help you.
entries.source_text: Problems? Maybe I can help you.

entries.text: Like you are the only one with problems.
entries.source_text: Like you are the only one with problems.

entries.text: Okay, okay. No reason to yell at me.
entries.source_text: Okay, okay. No reason to yell at me.

entries.text: Hmm... I don't know. It takes a different caliber of hero than you. Listen, why don't you come back when you have a little more experience under your belt?
entries.source_text: Hmm... I don't know. It takes a different caliber of hero than you. Listen, why don't you come back when you have a little more experience under your belt?

entries.text: This is a tragedy, believe me. Nothing is the way it used to be. I have a small farm outside town and a few days ago a bunch of Raiders appeared out of nowhere and now use my home as their camp. They killed Pugsley, my donkey and they threatened to kill me if I ever dare to come back.
entries.source_text: This is a tragedy, believe me. Nothing is the way it used to be. I have a small farm outside town and a few days ago a bunch of Raiders appeared out of nowhere and now use my home as their camp. They killed Pugsley, my donkey and they threatened to kill me if I ever dare to come back.

entries.text: Just tell me where and I'll take care of the rest.
entries.source_text: Just tell me where and I'll take care of the rest.

entries.text: Sorry Irwin, but I have more important things to do.
entries.source_text: Sorry Irwin, but I have more important things to do.

entries.text: Really, you would do that? You know, I don't dare to go there any more. Why don't you come back and let me know when it is safe to go back home again?
entries.source_text: Really, you would do that? You know, I don't dare to go there any more. Why don't you come back and let me know when it is safe to go back home again?

entries.text: Listen freak, I told you to let me alone in the first place. Now beat it!
entries.source_text: Listen freak, I told you to let me alone in the first place. Now beat it!

entries.text: I knew you would chicken out. Everyone does when it comes to the Raiders.
entries.source_text: I knew you would chicken out. Everyone does when it comes to the Raiders.

entries.text: So, have you been able to teach those Raiders a lesson? Is my home safe again?
entries.source_text: So, have you been able to teach those Raiders a lesson? Is my home safe again?

entries.text: It sure is, buddy.
entries.source_text: It sure is, buddy.

entries.text: I didn't have the time yet to take care of it.
entries.source_text: I didn't have the time yet to take care of it.

entries.text: Oh, thank you so much. I am sorry I don't have any riches to give to you, but here, take this rifle for saving my home.
entries.source_text: Oh, thank you so much. I am sorry I don't have any riches to give to you, but here, take this rifle for saving my home.

entries.text: You're trying to fool me, right? Please don't play with me. Come back and let me know when it is really safe to get back into my home, will you?
entries.source_text: You're trying to fool me, right? Please don't play with me. Come back and let me know when it is really safe to get back into my home, will you?

entries.text: Thank you so much for helping me.
entries.source_text: Thank you so much for helping me.

entries.text: Grunk?
entries.source_text: Grunk?

entries.text: Look, I don't have time for idiots.  Come back when you've got some smarts.
entries.source_text: Look, I don't have time for idiots.  Come back when you've got some smarts.

entries.text: Uh Huh, Uh Huh, Uh Huh.  I dood it.
entries.source_text: Uh Huh, Uh Huh, Uh Huh.  I dood it.

entries.text: Me no fix yet.
entries.source_text: Me no fix yet.

entries.text: Meet your maker!
entries.source_text: Meet your maker!

entries.text: Get him... dead!
entries.source_text: Get him... dead!

entries.text: You have just had your last cheesebread!
entries.source_text: You have just had your last cheesebread!

entries.text: I'll perforate you like some swiss cheese!
entries.source_text: I'll perforate you like some swiss cheese!
